messages:
tayla: quick sync — we need a single pinned changelog + docs link for the release post. can eng confirm final rollout window? :eyes:
sam: copying changelog + timeline now. target deploy window is 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC (canary) then 14:30 full for hosted. any objections?
rico: that slot works for product and webinar prep. tayla, is webinar push at 15:00 still?
tayla: yes webinar start is 15:00 UTC — marketing will open registrants 1hr prior. need the docs link so we can update slides / CTA.
ashley: I have the docs draft ready. will publish the stable page once sam confirms the exact artifact name. temporary URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/rls-2026-04-05
sam: final model artifact name is rwd-infer-v2.3.1. changelog snippet below — please pin this as the canonical changelog on the post and docs header:
```
### rwd-infer v2.3.1 (2026-04-05)
- Improved batching scheduler for mixed-latency workloads (+25% throughput)
- New quantization profiles for T4 and A10x (low-precision fast-path)
- Prefix KV cache warmup fixes to reduce cold-start latency
- Stability fixes for stream resumptions
```
tayla: perfect. marketing will use that verbatim. can you also confirm the one-line rollback policy we can publish? engineers want to show reliability posture in announcement.
sam: rollback policy: immediate model switch to v2.2.9 across region with traffic cutover (<3m). ops will run fallback probe at canary start.
ops-oncall: ops will run the probe and verify healthchecks at t+0 and t+3m, will post status in #eng-oncall. I'll tag deploy-bot to create a canary channel.
deploy-bot: Canary channel created: #deploy-1792134567-canary — will post rollouts and hooks.
ashley: published draft with pinned changelog and docs preview. final permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-2.3.1
tayla: beautiful. last item — inbound lead routing: we want registrants flagged as "release-webinar" and routed to SDR queue A. rico, can you confirm the webhook field?
rico: yes, webhook field should be campaign=release-webinar and source=announce-mailer. I'll send the mapping to integrations slack and tag @integrations.
tayla: thanks — can someone SME-review the benchmark paragraph? marketing wants a short blurb: "25% throughput improvement on mixed latency workloads using new scheduler"
sam: that's fair. small qualifier: "up to 25%" and note internal workload profile: mixed short+long sequences. use: "up to 25% throughput improvement on our mixed short/long sequence benchmark."
tayla: ok we'll use that wording. final checklist: 
- sam: confirm deploy timeframe (done)
- ashley: publish permalinks (done)
- rico: webhook mapping (in progress)
- ops-oncall: verify probes at canary (pending)
- tayla: update webinar CTA and push announcement at t-10m

sam: I'll post a short deploy note in the canary channel at T-30 and bump it at T-5. good to go from infra side.
tayla: thanks all, scheduling short pre-launch call at 13:30 UTC for last-minute checks. ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
